summary: Indivior Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting that its subsidiary Indivior UK Limited and Reckitt Benckiser Healthcare (UK) Limited executed a Deed of Variation and Termination on September 9, 2026, accelerating the termination date of their December 23, 2014 Copacker Supply Agreement to January 15, 2027. RB manufactures SUBOXONE and SUBUTEX tablets for Indivior under the agreement. Indivior has identified a new supplier, with obligations enforceable only after process validation. Costs payable to RB are fixed or capped and not material to the registrant. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; this is a routine supply-contract termination, not a special situation.
